description: As reparse-written-observation-head, where terms come before the optional. tt marks a written T by the first original token after $m, where its own span goes past $m. In the check, that token is F, so c is no reading, and the check passes (engine §7.4, §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A m [T] f
%rule b A m [T] [T] f
%rule c A $t(tt)
%conditions ~written ⊆ tags($t)
%rule tt $m(m) [T #] <text($) ≠ text($m) ∧ T ⊆ tags(head(after($m))) ⟹ ~written>
%rule # [{F}]
%rule f F
%rule m B
